Area.evidence_source: The participants talked about the masculinity image and the negative effects it had on them and the experience that men should not show their emotions. They all agreed that this stereotypic male image, this image of the strong and silent man, had a profound negative effect on their emotional life and resulted in emotional silencing. Henry talked about hiding behind a mask and burying his feelings: We are men, we are not supposed to talk about this and we are not allowed to express ourselves about emotions – this is the cost of manhood [...] we just block our feelings and then something comes up that pushes these points within us and then we actually have no resources in order to cope with these feelings or even face how we feel.
